info.title: Benefits Platform Benefits Webhooks API
info.description: The 'Benefits Webhooks' web service is a component of the Benefits Platform designed to allow updating of benefits related items.

post.summary:
Updates the deductible met status for a person.
This endpoint is really a passthrough to the cdh-benefit-strangler service.
Once execution is passed to the strangler, CDH monolith code will be run.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID generated by the Identity Management Service for accessing this specific person and it's related resources.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.
